app.title: Bulkut — local video editing
app.name: Bulkut
app.footer: Runs entirely in your browser with ffmpeg.wasm. Your files never leave this device.

engine.hint: The video engine (ffmpeg.wasm) loads on the first render.

suffix.label: Output suffix
suffix.hint: Appended to the file name before download.

common.oneAtATime: One video at a time, in launch order.

settings.title: Global settings
settings.hint: These values apply to every video that follows the defaults.

fields.thresholdHint: Loudness below this level is treated as silence.
fields.precutHint: Extra time kept just before speech starts.
fields.postcutHint: Breathing room kept just after speech ends.
fields.minClipHint: Kept clips shorter than this duration are dropped.

list.title: Videos
list.hint: Each video can override the global settings.

autocut.empty: No videos yet. Drop a few clips to remove their silences.

modal.title: Settings for “{name}”
modal.hint: Starts from the current values; applies to this video only.

excerpt.title: Render a 1-minute preview from the middle of the video

badge.custom: Uses settings specific to this video.

params.title: Threshold · pre-cut · post-cut · minimum clip duration

settings.title: Cut settings
settings.hint: Pick the start and end of the clip, then export.

list.title: Clip
list.hint: One file at a time; the sliders set the kept range.

settings.title: Reverse settings
settings.hint: Plays the clip and its audio backwards.

reverse.warning: Reversing buffers the whole clip in memory: keep it short (a few minutes).
reverse.longWarning: This clip is {duration} long: reversing buffers all of it in memory and may fail.

errors.numberRange: The value must be between {min} and {max}.
errors.notVideo: {name} is not a supported video file.
errors.busy: A video is already being processed.
errors.startBeforeEnd: The start must stay before the end (at least 1 second).
errors.endAfterStart: The end must stay after the start (at least 1 second).
errors.timecode: Enter a valid timecode between 00:00:00 and 99:59:59.
errors.duration: Could not read the video duration.
errors.noAudio: This video has no audio track to analyse.
errors.noSegments: No speech found with these settings. Try another threshold.
errors.tooManySegments: Too many segments to render ({max} max). Raise the threshold or the minimum silence.
errors.noVideoStream: No video stream found in this file.
errors.renderFailed: FFmpeg could not render this video.
errors.ffmpegUnavailable: The ffmpeg.wasm runtime is missing. Check the vendor/ffmpeg folder.
